findings.message: useContext is called without a reactive owner; Solid throws NoOwnerError ("Context can only be accessed under a reactive root.") here, so the read never returns a value
findings.hint: Read the context while a component, or a computation it creates, is being set up, and pass the value to the handler, timer or callback that needs it. A handler, a timer, a module-scope statement and code after an await run with no owner.
